The start and the end of a new event each get a time zone, as in HEY's own form.

![OmaCal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.4/preview.png)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88d5ff29-20e9-4e64-958d-b75dc3dade17

## New

- **A zone for the start and one for the end.** 1.0.3 gave the new-event form a single zone for both times. HEY keeps one for each, so the form now has a start zone and an end zone. The start is this machine's local time unless you type a city; the end is the start's zone unless you give it its own. A flight from Berlin at 10:00 to New York at 13:00 is saved as nine hours long. If the end is earlier than the start on the same day, the end goes on the next day.

| 1.0.3 | 1.0.4 |
| --- | --- |
| ![The quick-add card in 1.0.3, with one zone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.3/screenshots/quick-add.png) | ![The quick-add card in 1.0.4, with a start zone and an end zone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.4/screenshots/quick-add.png) |

## Known limitations

- **HEY shows an end with its own zone on the start's clock.** `hey event add` takes one time zone for both ends, so OmaCal saves the end at the right moment, converted to the start's zone. The flight above is stored correctly, but HEY shows its end as 19:00 Berlin time, not 13:00 New York time.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omacal.git --enable
omarchy plugin disable omarchy.clock
```

Already installed: `omarchy plugin update crmne.omacal`.

OmaCal is an independent project, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by HEY or 37signals.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/omacal/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4
